The Tesla Model S is not officially sold in India yet, so there isn’t an official retail price.  
If Tesla were to launch the Model S in India, the price would likely be in the range of **₹1.4–1.6 crore** (roughly $200 k–$230 k USD), taking into account import duties, GST, and local taxes.  

For the most accurate and up‑to‑date pricing, keep an eye on Tesla’s official announcements or local automotive news outlets.
